titles.native: ミラクル・サイキッカーセイザン

description: Takeru Aoyama, a young man, continues his journey in search of the Three Sacred Treasures in order to save humanity, bravely contending against the Chimimouryou (evil spirits of the mountains and rivers in the mythical Japanese bestiary).
